cells.value: Agent checkout against a merchant-hosted API, with a scoped delegated card token
cells.detail: The agent creates, updates and completes a checkout session; Delegate Payment swaps a card for a vault token bound by an allowance.

cells.value: Checkout and orders, payment credential handoff, discovery and feeds, post-purchase order events
cells.detail: No agent identity, reputation or user mandate layer.

cells.value: OpenAI and Stripe (founding maintainers); TSC: OpenAI, Stripe, Meta
cells.detail: Meta joined 2026-04-24; its own shopping agent Muse pays through Link, Shop Pay and PayPal, and no Meta or Stripe post on Muse mentions ACP (2026-11-14).

cells.value: Company-led TSC of up to 7 seats appointed by the founders; SEPs by simple majority; founders' block-only veto
cells.detail: No foundation; one is a stated long-term goal.

cells.value: Apache-2.0
cells.detail: Contributions under a corporate or individual CLA.
With ChatGPT Instant Checkout and Stripe SPTs.

cells.value: 2026-04-17 (dated folder)
cells.detail: No GitHub release or tag; folder edited after release (2026-05-01, 2026-06-15); last commit 2026-07-18, none through 2026-11-21.

cells.value: Beta spec, Draft RFCs; deployed for feeds in ChatGPT
cells.detail: 2025 in-chat checkout scaled back in March 2026; external checkout from ChatGPT plugins generally available; payment sheet in private beta. OpenAI's developer docs, rewritten on 2026-11-13, no longer describe ACP, and ChatGPT Wallet (2026-11-13) pays on merchant checkouts outside ACP; no commit since 2026-07-18 (as of 2026-11-21).

cells.value: REST over HTTPS, MCP binding (5 tools), webhooks, feed API and files
cells.detail: MCP binding released in 2026-04-17.

cells.value: Cards (FPAN or network token) through the merchant's PSP; seller-backed gift cards, points, store credit
cells.detail: SPTs can carry Link, wallets, Klarna and Affirm on Stripe.

cells.value: Bearer token per agent and merchant pair, agreed out of band; HMAC secret for webhooks
cells.detail: The merchant authenticates the agent with a bearer token; the agent verifies merchant webhooks with a shared HMAC secret. Detached Signature recommended; no registry or key directory.

cells.value: Buyer confirms in the agent UI; token limited by an allowance
cells.detail: No signed mandate or consent object.

cells.value: Human present
cells.detail: Every flow assumes the buyer confirms in session; no delegated standing authority.

cells.value: The merchant
cells.detail: OpenAI and PSPs are not merchant of record, as OpenAI's ACP docs said until 2026-11-13; for ChatGPT Wallet purchases OpenAI says the business handles the order, fulfillment, support and fraud decisions, and the Wallet terms (effective 2026-11-12) make the merchant the seller and merchant of record (2026-11-21).

cells.value: Single-use vault token (vt_) or Stripe SPT
cells.detail: Network tokens can sit under SPTs.

cells.value: TLS; HMAC-SHA256 webhooks; optional detached request signatures (Ed25519 or ES256 examples); 3DS2
cells.detail: Signature algorithms agreed out of band.

cells.value: Mandatory Idempotency-Key; one_time allowance; 300-second webhook window
cells.detail: Request Timestamp checks only SHOULD.

cells.value: allowance.max_amount and currency per token
cells.detail: Plus merchant, session and expiry scoping.

cells.value: None in the spec
cells.detail: Stripe SPTs can be revoked; sessions can be canceled.

cells.value: Merchant handles refunds and chargebacks; order adjustments report refund, return, dispute
cells.detail: No dispute protocol; a community dispute-resolution SEP (PR 316) awaits a sponsor (2026-11-21).

cells.value: Buyer contact, address and risk signals go to the merchant; card data only to the PSP or vault
cells.detail: Nothing public.

cells.value: /.well-known/acp.json per seller; push product feeds to the agent
cells.detail: No public registry.

cells.value: Registration required (bilateral onboarding)
cells.detail: For ChatGPT feeds, OpenAI's docs, rewritten on 2026-11-13, have a business claim its profile and verify its identity in Business Hub before uploading products; the merchant page still shows an application form and a waitlist (2026-11-14). Until that rewrite the docs limited feeds to approved partners.

cells.value: Centralized per platform
cells.detail: Each agent platform onboards merchants; founders control governance.

cells.value: 1 of 5
cells.detail: Only discovery documents and the GitHub repository are public.

cells.value: No protocol fee; OpenAI says no fees on purchases completed on the merchant's site or app (2026-11-14) and publishes no in-chat rate; the 2025 "small fee" and reported 4 percent are history
cells.detail: Merchant PSP fees unchanged; Stripe's US pricing page lists 0.15 USD per SPT issued (listed since at least 2026-04-23) without naming the party billed; Shopify may charge per-channel Agentic Storefronts fees set in Shopify Admin, but says selling in ChatGPT carries no fees beyond payment processing (2026-11-14). OpenAI states no fee for ChatGPT Wallet, which is not an ACP path; CNBC reports no cut to start (reported).

cells.value: Merchant pays its PSP; no OpenAI fee on external checkout (2026-11-14)
cells.detail: The 2025 in-chat platform fee statement is history; payment sheet pricing is unpublished. Card economics otherwise unchanged. ChatGPT Wallet, outside ACP: no fee stated by OpenAI; CNBC reports no cut to start (reported).

cells.value: REST, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, OpenRPC, EMV 3DS2, network tokens, HMAC-SHA256, RFC 8615, MCP, CommonMark
cells.detail: No VCs, DIDs, RFC 9421 or chains.

cells.value: Stripe SPT; Visa, Mastercard and American Express agent tokens under SPTs; UCP side by side
cells.detail: Stripe's seller SPT page names Amex ACE Kit beside Visa and Mastercard (2026-10-20); its agent page names Visa and Mastercard only. Stripe co-maintains ACP and gives ACP and UCP separate protocol pages; its hub paired 'UCP or ACP' until at least 2026-10-12. No documented link to x402, ERC-8004, AP2 or TAP itself; Visa Intelligent Commerce tokens sit under SPTs.

cells.value: No official SDK; the README names OpenAI's and Stripe's hosted services
cells.detail: The OpenAI docs the README links no longer document an ACP implementation (2026-11-14); Svix publishes unofficial types; package.json name not on npm.

cells.value: Named partners, no volume data
cells.detail: Seven retailers for discovery; Target, Walmart and Etsy apps in ChatGPT, and an Instacart app whose in-chat checkout OpenAI said on 2025-12-08 was powered by ACP (status unknown); Copilot and PayPal announcements; ACP integration docs from Checkout.com, Worldpay and PayPal (2026-11-14); no GMV published. Meta's own agent Muse documents no ACP use.

cells.value: Little: one formal model covering ACP among four protocols
cells.detail: No CVEs or advisories (GitHub repository advisory API 2026-11-21; NVD keyword search 2026-10-20); an audit-trail critique; a community security review of request signing filed as issue 331 (2026-11-20), not an advisory.

cells.value: Card rules, PCI DSS, SCA via 3DS, consumer protection; AI transparency on the surface
cells.detail: Merchant of record keeps tax and compliance; PCI DSS Level 1 applies to merchants that take raw card data through Delegate Payment.

cells.value: Does ACP checkout still run anywhere besides ChatGPT's marketplace payment sheet, and who else runs it in production?
cells.detail: No source answers it as of 2026-11-21: OpenAI's merchant page says ChatGPT shopping is built on ACP, but its rewritten commerce docs and ChatGPT Wallet do not mention ACP, and no 2026 source says whether the Instacart checkout that OpenAI said on 2025-12-08 was powered by ACP still runs.

radar.justification: Apache-2.0 spec in a public repository with a CLA, but the founders appoint the TSC and keep a veto.
Bilateral onboarding per platform and founder-controlled governance; no permissionless path.

Beta and Draft labels, mutable releases, examples that do not validate, and a quiet repository since 2026-07-18 (no maintainer comment, review, merge or commit between 2026-07-18 and 2026-11-21; the one maintainer action was closing SEP PR 178 unmerged on 2026-08-09).
Large named partners for feeds, but no published volume and a scaled-back checkout product; OpenAI's newest purchase path, ChatGPT Wallet (2026-11-13), is not presented as ACP.
Built around a buyer confirming in session; tokens are one-time and session bound.
Merchant handles chargebacks under card rules and reports adjustments; no dispute protocol.

controlsCells.note: The merchant authenticates the agent with a bearer token agreed out of band, plus a recommended detached Signature and Timestamp with algorithms agreed out of band; the agent verifies webhooks with a shared HMAC secret. No agent identity scheme. Outside the spec, ChatGPT's cloud browser signs certain requests with Web Bot Auth (2026-11-21).

No registry in ACP. Each platform runs its own merchant onboarding: for ChatGPT feeds, OpenAI's docs (rewritten 2026-11-13) have a business claim its profile and verify its identity in Business Hub, while OpenAI's merchant page keeps an application form and a waitlist (2026-11-21).

The buyer confirms in the agent interface (a product feature). The spec captures marketing consents and 3DS results but no signed purchase consent. Outside ACP, ChatGPT Wallet asks for a security check such as Face ID before each purchase (2026-11-13).
allowance.max_amount and currency on every delegated token; Stripe SPT usage_limits.max_amount.
allowance.merchant_id and allowance.checkout_session_id bind the token to one merchant and one session.
allowance.expires_at, session expires_at and the expired status.
No revoke endpoint in ACP; the agent can revoke a Stripe SPT until it is consumed or resolved. Agents can cancel open sessions.
authentication_required status, authentication_metadata, authentication_result, Delegate Authentication (3DS2) and capabilities.interventions.
Mandatory Idempotency-Key on POST since 2026-04-17, one_time allowance, webhook timestamp window; request Timestamp checks only SHOULD.
Order with permalink_url and order_create and order_update webhooks; no signed receipt.
Order adjustments include refund, return and dispute; the merchant handles chargebacks as merchant of record; no dispute protocol.
risk_signals on complete, RiskSignal entries on Delegate Payment, intent_trace reason codes on cancel, Request-Id.
Merchants can decline any order and agents can cancel sessions; Stripe SPTs can be revoked; no protocol-wide stop.
